Name: Azariah, Son of Hilkiah, Ruler
Summary: Son of Hilkiah son of Meshullam son of Zadok son of Meraioth son of Ahitub, ruler of the house of God.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:11: Son of Hilkiah son of Meshullam son of Zadok son of Meraioth son of Ahitub, ruler of the house of God.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Azariah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
